API ReferenceZIdentity APIAPI ClientsApiclient Ops Add
Apiclient Ops Add
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/ziam/admin/api/v1/api-clients

Creates a new API client with authentication settings and assigned roles.

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODYREQUIRED
name
string
REQUIRED

A descriptive name for the API client.

Possible values: <= 128 characters

description
string

A brief description of the API client.

Possible values: <= 256 characters

status
boolean

Whether the API client needs to be active true or disabled false.

accessTokenLifeTime
int32
REQUIRED

The lifetime (in seconds) of the access token issued to this API client. Example: 60 for 60 minutes.

Possible values: >= 60 and <= 86400

clientAuthentication
object
REQUIRED
clientResources
object[]
REQUIRED
Responses
​
201
202
400

The request has succeeded and a new resource has been created as a result.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
name
string
REQUIRED

The name of the OAuth2 client.

Possible values: <= 128 characters

description
string

A description of the client.

Possible values: <= 256 characters

status
boolean

Whether the client is active (true) or inactive (false).

accessTokenLifeTime
int32
REQUIRED

Specifies how long (in seconds) the access token remains valid.

Possible values: >= 60 and <= 86400

clientAuthentication
object
REQUIRED
clientResources
object[]
REQUIRED
id
string
REQUIRED

Unique identifier of the OAuth2 client.
